state.task: Given two CAD parts and their B-Rep face geometry, determine which assembly mate types are appropriate between the two parts. Do not infer from any ground-truth mate labels; use only the part data.

instructions: Do Part A and Part B require at least one concentric assembly mate?
A concentric mate means cylindrical or rotational features of the two parts are intended to share an axis.

criteria.true: At least one concentric mate is appropriate between these two parts.
criteria.false: No concentric mate is appropriate between these two parts.

instructions: Do Part A and Part B require at least one coincident assembly mate?
A coincident mate means planar faces of the two parts are intended to contact or coincide.

criteria.true: At least one coincident mate is appropriate between these two parts.
criteria.false: No coincident mate is appropriate between these two parts.
